select null, null, null, null, if(IFNULL(portfolioName,'1'), null, flowTestId) AS flowTestId, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from ( select t.*, if(ligValSceBre >=0, '-', cast(ligValFlowMonBrePre as char)) as ligValFlowMonBre, if (medValSceBre >=0, '-', cast(medValFlowMonBrePre as char)) as medValFlowMonBre, if (heaValSceBre >=0, '-', cast(heaValFlowMonBrePre as char)) as heaValFlowMonBre from (select DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as baseDate, DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testEndDate, DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') as startTime, t.test_id as flowTestId, sst.test_name as testName, t.object_id as portfolioId, so.object_name as portfolioName, t.object_id as finprodId, so.object_name as finprodName, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001',round(re1.value,2),null)) as finprodAmt, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1002',round(re1.value,2),null)) as purOfNetOutflow, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1007',round(re1.value,2),null)) as cashBal, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1008',round(re1.value,4),null)) as leverRate,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001001',round(re1.value,2),null)) as oneLast, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001002',round(re1.value,2),null)) as twoLast, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001003',round(re1.value,2),null)) as inCount, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001004',round(re1.value,2),null)) as outCount,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1003',round(-1*re1.light_value,2),null)) as ligValSceBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1009',round(-1*re1.light_value,2),null)) as ligValRiskSlowBreOne, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1004',round(-1*re1.light_value,2),null)) as ligValRiskSlowBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1005',round(abs(re1.light_value),4),null)) as ligValFlowMonBrePre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1006',round(re1.light_value,4),null)) as ligValLeverRate,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1003',round(-1*re1.medium_value,2),null)) as medValSceBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1009',round(-1*re1.medium_value,2),null)) as medValRiskSlowBreOne, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1004',round(-1*re1.medium_value,2),null)) as medValRiskSlowBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1005',round(abs(re1.medium_value),4),null)) as medValFlowMonBrePre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1006',round(re1.medium_value,4),null)) as medValLeverRate,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1003',round(-1*re1.heavy_value,2),null)) as heaValSceBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1009',round(-1*re1.heavy_value,2),null)) as heaValRiskSlowBreOne, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1004',round(-1*re1.heavy_value,2),null)) as heaValRiskSlowBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1005',round(abs(re1.heavy_value),4),null)) as heaValFlowMonBrePre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1006',round(re1.heavy_value,4),null)) as heaValLeverRate from STT_TEST_OBJ t left join STT_OBJECT so on so.object_id=t.object_id left join STT_STRESS_TEST sst on t.test_id=sst.test_id left join ( select t.seq_no, t.test_id, t.object_id, t.scene_id, t.ind_id, t.value_struct, t.value, t.value_type, v.light_value, v.heavy_value, v.medium_value from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t left join STT_INDDATA_LMH v on t.seq_no = v.seq_no and t.test_id = v.test_id where t.test_id = #{testId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) re1 on t.test_id=re1.test_id and t.object_id=re1.object_id where sst.exe_status='01' and t.test_id = #{testId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss'), t.test_id, sst.test_name, t.object_id, so.object_name, t.object_id, so.object_name )t ) t

portfolioName, finprodId, finprodName, sum(finprodAmt) finprodAmt, sum(purOfNetOutflow) purOfNetOutflow, sum(cashBal) cashBal, sum(leverRate) leverRate, sum(oneLast) oneLast, sum(twoLast) twoLast, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1007',round(re1.value,2),null)) as cashBal, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1008',round(re1.value,4),null)) as leverRate,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001001',round(re1.value,2),null)) as oneLast, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001002',round(re1.value,2),null)) as twoLast, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001003',round(re1.value,2),null)) as inCount, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1001004',round(re1.value,2),null)) as outCount,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1003',round(-1*re1.light_value,2),null)) as ligValSceBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1009',round(-1*re1.light_value,2),null)) as ligValRiskSlowBreOne, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1004',round(-1*re1.light_value,2),null)) as ligValRiskSlowBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1005',round(abs(re1.light_value),4),null)) as ligValFlowMonBrePre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1006',round(re1.light_value,4),null)) as ligValLeverRate,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1003',round(-1*re1.medium_value,2),null)) as medValSceBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1009',round(-1*re1.medium_value,2),null)) as medValRiskSlowBreOne, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1004',round(-1*re1.medium_value,2),null)) as medValRiskSlowBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1005',round(abs(re1.medium_value),4),null)) as medValFlowMonBrePre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1006',round(re1.medium_value,4),null)) as medValLeverRate,
sum(if(re1.ind_id='1003',round(-1*re1.heavy_value,2),null)) as heaValSceBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1009',round(-1*re1.heavy_value,2),null)) as heaValRiskSlowBreOne, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1004',round(-1*re1.heavy_value,2),null)) as heaValRiskSlowBre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1005',round(abs(re1.heavy_value),4),null)) as heaValFlowMonBrePre, sum(if(re1.ind_id='1006',round(re1.heavy_value,4),null)) as heaValLeverRate from STT_TEST_OBJ t left join STT_OBJECT so on so.object_id=t.object_id left join STT_STRESS_TEST sst on t.test_id=sst.test_id left join ( select t.seq_no, t.test_id, t.object_id, t.scene_id, t.ind_id, t.value_struct, t.value, t.value_type, v.light_value, v.heavy_value, v.medium_value from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t left join STT_INDDATA_LMH v on t.seq_no = v.seq_no and t.test_id = v.test_id where t.test_id = #{testId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) re1 on t.test_id=re1.test_id and t.object_id=re1.object_id where sst.exe_status='01' and t.test_id = #{testId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss'), t.test_id, sst.test_name, t.object_id, so.object_name, t.object_id, so.object_name )t ) t

select DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as baseDate,--分析基准日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testStartDate,--分析开始日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testEndDate,--分析结束日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') as startTime,--压测执行时间 sst.test_id as flowTestId,--测试id sst.remark,--备注 t2.tips_value as openMode, concat_ws('',t1.scene_id,':',ss.scene_name) as sceneIdAndsceneName FROM STT_STRESS_TEST sst left join STT_STRESS_SCENE t1 on sst.test_id=t1.BUSI_ID and t1.stt_busi_type='04'--业务类型是04:压力测试 left join stt_scene_tips t2 on t1.scene_id=t2.scene_id and t2.dict_code = 'OPENMODE'--适用产品（开放类型） left join stt_scene ss on t1.scene_id=ss.scene_id WHERE sst.test_id = #{testId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
